# Field boundaries for Czech

Czech field boundaries (2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Czech Ministry of Agriculture (Ministr Zemědělství). License: CC0-1.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/cz/latest/cz.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/cz/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:4258; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: geometry, collection, crop:name, hcat:code, id, block_id, hcat:name_en, crop:code, hcat:name, metrics:area, determination:datetime, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/cz/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/cz/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/cz/collection.json
